description: When import_email or Email/set create adds an email to a mailbox, the stored Mailbox object's totalEmails and totalThreads fields are not incremented. RFC 8621 §2 requires these to be accurate counts. The MemoryBackend.import_email inserts the Email object but never updates the Mailbox aggregate counts. Fix: after inserting a new email, scan all mailboxes the email belongs to and update totalEmails += 1 (and totalThreads if new thread). Oracle: RFC 8621 §2, jmap-test-suite mailbox-get.test.ts conformance_mailbox_get_total_emails.
title: jmap-mail-server: totalEmails/unreadEmails never updated on Mailbox
